headline: A bicycle trailer that is always there when you need it.

idea.heading: The Concept
idea.body: Temporary Cargo makes additional carrying capacity part of the bicycle itself. Integrated into the rear of the bike, it transforms from a compact rack into a single-wheel trailer when needed — turning virtually any bicycle into a cargo bike on demand.

result.heading: The Result
result.bodyBlack: A fully functional prototype that adds cargo capacity without compromising everyday use. Folded, Temporary Cargo functions as a rear rack. When needed, it unfolds into a single-wheel trailer with a 300 × 400 mm cargo platform.

problem.heading: The Problem
problem.body: Bicycles are efficient for everyday mobility — until you need to carry something. Cargo bikes and trailers solve this problem, but their size and inconvenience make them difficult to justify for occasional use.
